column1: # Archival forcing corpus — per-cell forceability register (AFC-1).
# Pin: a6160a4bd. Denominator: 17 tables x 2 halves = 34 cells.
# Anchors re-resolved 2026-09-14 on the PL-D3 implementation branch (the
# same symbols, at the lines the branch moved them to).
# Table set is derived from the X(LMDB_ARCHIVAL_ ...) X-macro at
# symbol is the EXACT identifier that must appear at `site`. It is a typed
# column, not prose: the anchor leg matches THIS and nothing else, so a note
# reworded or a line drifted cannot silently keep a citation green.

column6: held under writer-round 5.1 pending SO-D8; unit KAT exists, LMDB-bound
delete runs but cannot discriminate; only write is mdb_cursor_del, no counter
no emitter exists: tree says "Empty on local mine and until the Phase 2/3 template writer populates it"; FFI exposes verify + pass_p_ids only
remove_archival_attestation_witness_at_height is a lone mdb_del, no counter, no side effect
stores connect.attestation_witness, which no in-tree emitter ever populates; same blocker as the main-chain row
remove_archival_alt_attestation_witness is a lone mdb_del, no counter, no side effect
process_archival_segment_freezes_at_height; COST: needs 25992 curve-tree leaves, segment_leaf_count is NOT a tunable
mdb_put m_archival_slash_applied via apply_archival_slash_one; needs a bond record + failed challenge, NOT a settlement row
mdb_put m_archival_slash_log; the epoch MARKER is unconditional once per such height, so cheaper to force than slash_applied
